MESA Core · v0.9.0

HTTP endpoint reference

v0.9.0 commit: 7062faf source: docs/api-reference.md

This guide has equivalent English and Turkish versions. The source sections behind this page are at the bottom.

Overview#

Generated from the OpenAPI document published with Core v0.9.0 (commit 7062faf). Example bodies are built from the schema to show the shape of a request; they are not recorded server responses.

Every endpoint except /health/init needs the X-API-Key header. What a V4 call may touch is limited by the roles granted to that key; see Security & Scope.

Download the OpenAPI JSON

Get Capability · Requires X-API-Key.

Example

json

    "string"

    "idempotent_ingestion": true,

  "validation": {

    "validator_count": 0
  },

    "rebuild_scope": "storage_root",
    "requires_offline_runner": true
  }
}
